_meta.europeanPlacesNote: UEFA allocation varies by country coefficient. The two countries with the best club coefficient each season earn an extra Champions League place (European Performance Spot). Domestic cup winners usually take a Europa League place.

leagues.name: Premier League
leagues.europe: Top 4 → UCL (5th too if England earns a European Performance Spot); 5th → UEL; 6th → UECL play-off; FA Cup winner → UEL; EFL Cup winner → UECL play-off
leagues.notes: 2024-25 champions: Liverpool. Promoted for 2025-26: Leeds, Burnley, Sunderland. Relegated 2024-25: Leicester, Ipswich, Southampton. Everton moved to Hill Dickinson Stadium (Bramley-Moore Dock) in 2025.

leagues.name: EFL Championship
leagues.notes: Oxford United: home of Indonesia internationals Ole Romeny and (2024-25) Marselino Ferdinan.

leagues.name: LALIGA EA SPORTS
leagues.europe: Top 4 → UCL (+5th via European Performance Spot); 5th → UEL; 6th → UECL play-off; Copa del Rey winner → UEL
leagues.notes: 2024-25 champions: Barcelona. Promoted: Levante, Elche, Real Oviedo. Barcelona returned to the rebuilt Spotify Camp Nou during 2025-26 (partial capacity at first).

leagues.name: Primera Federación
leagues.format: 2 groups of 20; group winners promoted, 2nd-5th play-offs

countries.supercup: Supercopa de España (4 teams, January, Saudi Arabia)
stars: Marcus Rashford (Barcelona, loan from Man Utd)

leagues.name: Bundesliga
leagues.relegation: 17th-18th relegated; 16th plays two-leg relegation play-off vs 2. Bundesliga 3rd
leagues.europe: Top 4 → UCL; 5th → UEL; 6th → UECL play-off; DFB-Pokal winner → UEL
leagues.notes: 2024-25 champions: Bayern. Promoted: 1. FC Köln, Hamburger SV. Relegated: Holstein Kiel, VfL Bochum. 50+1 ownership rule: fans/members control clubs (except Leverkusen, Wolfsburg, Hoffenheim exemptions; Leipzig's structure is controversial).

leagues.name: Serie A Enilive
leagues.europe: Top 4 → UCL; 5th → UEL; 6th → UECL play-off; Coppa Italia winner → UEL
leagues.notes: 2024-25 champions: Napoli (Antonio Conte). Promoted: Sassuolo, Pisa, Cremonese. Relegated: Empoli, Venezia, Monza.

leagues.name: Serie B BKT
leagues.notes: Brescia was excluded in 2025 for financial reasons; Sampdoria survived as a result.

leagues.name: Serie C Sky Wifi
leagues.format: 3 groups of 20 (North, Centre, South); 3 winners + 1 play-off winner promoted

countries.supercup: Supercoppa Italiana (4 teams, December/January, Saudi Arabia)

leagues.name: Ligue 1 McDonald's
leagues.relegation: Bottom 2 relegated; 16th plays play-off vs Ligue 2 3rd-5th play-off winner
leagues.europe: Top 3 → UCL; 4th → UCL qualifying; 5th → UEL; 6th → UECL play-off; Coupe de France winner → UEL
leagues.notes: 2024-25: PSG won the treble including their first Champions League (5-0 vs Inter). Promoted: Lorient, Paris FC, Metz. Relegated: Montpellier, Saint-Étienne, Reims (play-off). Lyon was provisionally relegated by the DNCG in 2025 then reinstated on appeal.

leagues.name: Ligue 2 BKT
leagues.promotion: Top 2 automatic; 3rd-5th play-offs, winner faces Ligue 1 16th
leagues.relegation: Bottom 2 relegated; 16th plays play-off vs National 3rd

leagues.name: National
leagues.notes: verify: exact count changed after 2025 administrative relegations.

countries.supercup: Trophée des Champions (date and venue vary, often abroad)

leagues.name: Liga Portugal Betclic
leagues.relegation: Bottom 2 relegated; 16th plays play-off vs Liga 2 3rd
leagues.europe: Top 2 → UCL (2nd via qualifying); 3rd → UEL qualifying; 4th-5th → UECL qualifying; Taça winner → UEL
leagues.notes: 2024-25 champions: Sporting CP (double). José Mourinho became Benfica coach in September 2025.

leagues.name: Liga Portugal 2 Meu Super
leagues.notes: verify: Boavista was demoted to the amateur leagues in 2025 for financial reasons.

leagues.name: Liga 3
leagues.format: 2 series, then promotion and relegation phases

leagues.name: VriendenLoterij Eredivisie
leagues.europe: 1st → UCL; 2nd → UCL qualifying; 3rd → UEL qualifying; play-offs for UECL; KNVB Cup winner → UEL
leagues.notes: 2024-25 champions: PSV. Relegated: Willem II, RKC Waalwijk, Almere City. Many Indonesian national team players were developed in Dutch academies.

leagues.name: Keuken Kampioen Divisie (Eerste Divisie)
leagues.notes: Vitesse lost its professional licence in 2025. Reserve (Jong) teams cannot be promoted. verify: count may be 19 after Vitesse's removal.

leagues.name: Tweede Divisie
leagues.notes: Semi-professional. (The Hoofdklasse in the original prompt is a lower amateur tier, not tier 3.)

leagues.name: Jupiler Pro League
leagues.format: 30 rounds, then Champions' play-off (top 6, points halved), Europe play-off (7-12) and relegation play-off (13-16)
leagues.notes: 2024-25 champions: Union SG (first title in 90 years). Relegated: Kortrijk, Beerschot. Ragnar Oratmangoen (Indonesia) plays for Dender.

leagues.name: Challenger Pro League
leagues.notes: The original prompt said 8 clubs; it is 16 including U23 sides. Joey Pelupessy (Indonesia) plays for Lommel.

leagues.name: William Hill Scottish Premiership
leagues.format: 33 rounds then split into top 6 / bottom 6
leagues.notes: 2024-25 champions: Celtic (4 in a row). Aberdeen won the 2025 Scottish Cup. Promoted: Falkirk, Livingston. Relegated: St Johnstone, Ross County.

leagues.name: Trendyol Süper Lig
leagues.notes: League reduced from 19 to 18 clubs. 2024-25 champions: Galatasaray (3 in a row). Relegated: Adana Demirspor, Hatayspor, Sivasspor, Bodrum. Foreign-player quota changes frequently. Turkish football is volatile: managers are sacked quickly, fan pressure is extreme.

leagues.name: ADMIRAL Bundesliga
leagues.format: 22 rounds, then championship group (6) and qualification group (6), points halved
leagues.notes: 2024-25 champions: Sturm Graz.

leagues.name: Credit Suisse Super League (Brack.ch Super League from 2025, verify)
leagues.format: 33 rounds then split into top 6 / bottom 6
leagues.notes: League expanded to 12 clubs in 2023 (the original prompt said 10). 2024-25 champions: Basel (Xherdan Shaqiri). verify sponsor name.

leagues.name: Chance Liga
leagues.notes: Renamed from Fortuna Liga (2024). 2024-25 champions: Slavia Praha.

leagues.name: 3F Superliga
leagues.format: 22 rounds then championship round (6) and relegation round (6)
leagues.notes: 12 clubs (the original prompt said 14). 2024-25 champions: FC København.

leagues.name: Eliteserien
leagues.notes: 2025 season list. 2025 champions: Viking. Bodø/Glimt reached the 2024-25 Europa League semi-finals and the 2025-26 Champions League league phase. verify 2026 promoted/relegated clubs.

leagues.name: Allsvenskan
leagues.notes: 2025 season list. 2025 champions: Mjällby (historic first title). verify 2026 changes.

leagues.name: PKO BP Ekstraklasa
leagues.notes: 2024-25 champions: Lech Poznań. Wisła Kraków is in the 2nd tier (I liga) in 2025-26.

leagues.name: Stoiximan Super League
leagues.notes: 2024-25 champions: Olympiacos (double). Olympiacos won the 2023-24 Conference League.

leagues.name: SuperSport HNL
leagues.notes: 2024-25 champions: Rijeka.

leagues.name: Mozzart Bet SuperLiga
leagues.notes: Red Star are dominant champions.

leagues.name: Ukrainian Premier League (VBET League)
leagues.notes: 2024-25 champions: Dynamo Kyiv. Played during the war, often behind closed doors, with air-raid interruptions. Ukrainian clubs play European home matches abroad. Dnipro-1 dissolved in 2024 and Vorskla were relegated in 2025 (the original prompt listed both).

leagues.name: Russian Premier League (Mir RPL)
leagues.notes: 2024-25 champions: Krasnodar (ending Zenit's run). Russian clubs and the national team remain banned from UEFA and FIFA competitions.

leagues.name: Superliga
leagues.notes: 2024-25 champions: FCSB.

leagues.name: NB I (Fizz Liga)
leagues.notes: Ferencváros dominant (2024-25 champions).

leagues.name: Niké liga
leagues.notes: AS Trenčín has a history of hosting Indonesian players (Marselino Ferdinan joined on loan in 2025, verify).

leagues.name: efbet Liga (First League)
leagues.notes: Ludogorets have won every title since 2011-12.

leagues.name: Cyprus League (Cyta Championship)
leagues.notes: 2024-25 champions: Pafos, who reached the 2025-26 Champions League league phase.

leagues.name: Ligat Ha'Al
leagues.notes: Israeli clubs play UEFA home matches at neutral venues (Hungary/Serbia) because of the security situation.

leagues.name: Kazakhstan Premier League
leagues.notes: Kairat reached the 2025-26 Champions League league phase, travelling up to ~7,000 km for away games.

leagues.name: Azerbaijan Premier League
leagues.notes: Qarabağ dominant; 2025-26 Champions League league phase.

leagues.name: Belarusian Premier League (Vysheyshaya Liga)
leagues.notes: Belarusian clubs play UEFA home matches at neutral venues.

leagues.name: League of Ireland Premier Division (SSE Airtricity)
leagues.notes: 2025 season list. Shamrock Rovers won 2025. verify 2026 promotion/relegation (Dundalk).
